summary: Fix run-auto-integrator.sh so --execute mode no longer overrides auto_integrator.py's promoted DEFAULT_LIVE_CONFIG with the repo-committed .orchestrator/config.json template (which has no per-repository integration_path). PANTHEON_LIVE_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG is now only exported when the caller explicitly sets PANTHEON_AUTO_INTEGRATOR_CONFIG, so an un-overridden --execute run correctly binds to the promoted live-supervisor-mainroot-config.json and its configured dedicated integration_path checkout instead of silently falling back to the shared dev-root checkout. Dry-run mode is unchanged.
verification: python3 -m pytest scripts/test_run_auto_integrator.py scripts/test_auto_integrator_install.py scripts/git/test_auto_integrator.py -q (95 passed, 5 subtests passed)
